description: Additional kind-availability coverage across a core catalog and one regular catalog. A kind listed for the matching bare or group/version is available; a kind listed only under a different version, a version unknown to every catalog, and an unmatched group/version all report unavailable.

cases.expected_output:
api_version=v1 kind=Secret available=true
api_version=v1 kind=ConfigMap available=true
api_version=apps/v1 kind=DaemonSet available=true
api_version=apps/v1 kind=Deployment available=true
api_version=v1 kind=Deployment available=false
api_version=apps/v1 kind=Pod available=false
api_version=v2 kind=Pod available=false
api_version=batch/v1 kind=Job available=false
